title: Detailed car replacement verified in the current app
summary: Authored textured car replaces the blocky sedan with cockpit, opening panels and verified local app integration.

changes.detail: 109 authored mesh primitives and 213347 triangles with original textures, licensed source asset, provenance and visible attribution.
Door/hood/hatch pivots, cockpit camera, showroom framing, glazing and paint-normal rendering; six actual visual groups with BMW lessons identified as comparisons.
Procedural sedan from default rendering; source retained for previous development tests.
Transform anchors preserve children during cutaway; shared-material adjustment runs once; test harness now awaits imported model readiness and excludes unsupported Chassis.

validation.name: Build, TypeScript and lint
validation.detail: Studio bundle build (16415445 bytes), typecheck and focused ESLint passed.

validation.name: Model and visual verification
validation.detail: Detailed smoke passed SHA-256, 109 meshes/213347 triangles, six groups, zero external requests, opening/closing hinges, cockpit, isolate, paint, X-ray, raycasting, pause/disposal and 320/390/844px layouts. Desktop/mobile/open/cockpit screenshots inspected.

validation.name: Multilingual and GLB regression
validation.detail: EN/FR/AR learning, quizzes, progress, guided tour, simulation/layout and GLB fixture rendering/interaction/recovery passed.

validation.name: Live app integration
validation.detail: localhost:8082 navigation, imported canvas, saved/restored progress and visible history passed using synthetic auth. Initial reload timeout resolved in test with an explicit model-ready wait; rerun passed.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: No physical Android/iOS GPU or memory tests, APK rebuild or deployment. Detailed concept car is not a production BMW replica. Six visual groups modeled; other systems remain lessons. Viewer bundle about 16.4 MB.
